$comment: Differences between the app and the spreadsheets that are known and intended.
Used by `npm run compare:excel` so a deliberate change doesn't leave the check
permanently red — a check that always fails is a check nobody reads.
SAFETY: an acceptance only ever applies when ALL of that year's totals still
match (income, operating expenses, capital, NOI). It can therefore excuse money
being RECLASSIFIED between lines, but never money appearing or disappearing. If
a total moves, the year fails regardless of what's listed here.
Deliberately records no dollar amounts: this file is committed, and the repo
must never contain real figures. It also means acceptances don't go stale when
`lines` uses the same labels the comparison prints: '+' for income, '−' for
expense (that's U+2212, not a hyphen), and 'Category › Subcategory'.

acceptedDifferences.reason: Part of Other Income was deliberately reclassified as Rent in the app (2026-08-16). The spreadsheet still splits it the old way; total income is unchanged.
Other Income was deliberately merged into Rent in the app (2026-08-16). The spreadsheet still splits the two; total income is unchanged.
